entries.sender_task_title: Recover atomic terminal routing in an isolated workspace
entries.source_prompt: CI recovery complete. Exact cause: (1) Static Checks job 101998917597 rejected coordinator_grants.go's sqlite_master probe because it lacked an exact sqlguard exemption. (2) Backend Postgres job 101998917409 hit `could not open relation with OID ...` while coordinatorGrantSchemaCurrent called pg_get_constraintdef during concurrent isolated-schema cleanup; its relation-name catalog scan could inspect stale constraints from other schemas. Fixed on successor b161ff0ce3aa3e48e3bcdefff02d3428b5beff96 (pushed fast-forward to recovery and canonical fix/atomic-terminal-routing): split the SQLite probe behind the explicit dialect helper with its narrow guard exemption, and replace the PostgreSQL rendered-DDL catalog scan with a current-schema structural FK check (relation/columns/cascade). Added Postgres regression proving another schema's correct FK cannot make the local legacy schema appear current. Validation passed: targeted regression plus SQLite migration test; `go run ./cmd/sqlguard ./internal`; `KANDEV_TEST_POSTGRES_DSN=... go test -race ./internal/persistence/storeconformance -run '^TestStoreConformance$' -count=1` (53.7s); and `... go test -race ./internal/task/repository/sqlite/... -count=1` (255.5s). Commit hooks passed; git auto-gc emitted unrelated read-only shared-worktree lock diagnostics after commit, but commit succeeded.
